how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-loch-modan-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:161:obj:0: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to take the strange smelling powder to Ashlan Stonesmirk, the explosives expert in Dun Modr.
rows.quest:161:details:0: If my suspicions are correct, this is some type of explosive powder. This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here. Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span. I need you to make a grave and perilous journey, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:161:details:1: BTravel through the Algaz Gate, follow the road through the ⟦E1⟧ and seek out Stonesmirk in Dun Modr. Heed my advice: stick to the roads and stop for nothing!
rows.quest:161:completion:0: Ah, well Ol' Hinderweir is wise to be worried.
rows.quest:199:obj:0: Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.
rows.quest:199:details:0: You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.
rows.quest:199:completion:0: This is an alarming discovery, to say the least!
rows.quest:217:obj:0: Kill the Trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.
rows.quest:217:details:0: ⟦2⟧, our scouts have identified the leader of this recent Trogg incursion. It appears that these beasts in ⟦E2⟧ are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug. Grawmug is heavily guarded, however. Two of his most elite guards, Gnasher and Brawler, never leave his side.
rows.quest:217:details:1: BIf you feel yourself worthy, ⟦3⟧, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs. With the Trogg leadership dead, we just might stand a chance at pushing these beasts back into the ground.
rows.quest:217:completion:0: Most excellent, ⟦4⟧! You have brought hope to ⟦E2⟧. With Grawmug dead, we stand a better chance of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.
rows.quest:224:obj:0: Mountaineer Cobbleflint of the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts.
rows.quest:224:details:0: We need to protect the Loch, ⟦5⟧! With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front. Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice! The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to ⟦E3⟧. These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.
rows.quest:224:details:1: BWe need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat. Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.
rows.quest:224:completion:0: Well done, ⟦6⟧! You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield. Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours. You have served King Magni well.
rows.quest:224:completion:1: BIf you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw. The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with. Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.
rows.quest:237:obj:0: Mountaineer Gravelgaw in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers and report back to him.
rows.quest:237:details:0: Mountaineer Cobbleflint had nothing but good things to say about you, ⟦7⟧. For that reason I am going to entrust upon you a mission of utmost importance. We need to keep pressure on the invading Trogg forces until our Dwarven brethren return from the ⟦E4⟧ front.
rows.quest:237:details:1: BSet forth into the southern hills and kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers. Your attacks will buy us some time. Report back when your mission is complete.
rows.quest:237:completion:0: You accomplished your mission well, ⟦8⟧. The King himself would be proud.
rows.quest:237:completion:1: BThe reinforcements promised to us never showed, however. Apparently the ⟦E4⟧ front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren. The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth. But we must not let their deaths go for naught. We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:237:completion:2: BSpeak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment. You're needed now more than ever.
rows.quest:250:obj:0: Investigate the area near the eastern ramp of the Dam and bring Chief Engineer Hinderweir a clue that might reveal what the Dark Iron Dwarves are up to.
rows.quest:250:details:0: Thank the stars someone is concerned about the well-being of the Dam. First the destruction of the Thandol Span and then the pillaging of Dun Modr! I have no doubt that the Dam will be the target of the next Dark Iron threat. Most of the security detail here was reassigned to the ⟦E4⟧ Front, including my top inspector.
rows.quest:250:details:1: BThat's why I need you, ⟦9⟧. I spotted some Dark Iron Sappers milling about the eastern ramp of the Dam. Investigate the area and bring back a clue.
rows.quest:250:completion:0: The suspicious looking barrel contains a strange smelling powder.
rows.quest:255:obj:0: Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar has hired you to kill 4 Mo'grosh Ogres, 4 Mo'grosh Brutes and 4 Mo'grosh Enforcers.
rows.quest:255:details:0: Two months just to hear from ⟦E3⟧ that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.
rows.quest:255:details:1: BI've no choice then, it seems. I'll need hired arms.
rows.quest:255:details:2: BHow about you? You seem a likely sort, ⟦10⟧. A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. Perhaps you will be the one to remove the threat to our town?
rows.quest:255:completion:0: Ah, this is excellent news! Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.
rows.quest:256:obj:0: Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.
rows.quest:256:details:0: By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:
rows.quest:256:details:1: BChok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.
rows.quest:256:details:2: BMonetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.
rows.quest:256:details:3: BChok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:256:completion:0: Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...
rows.quest:256:completion:1: BBloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.
rows.quest:257:obj:0: Kill 6 Mountain Buzzards and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 15 minutes.
rows.quest:257:details:0: Think you can match wits with Daryl the Bold, huh? I should think not! Of course, you're more than welcome to try. Here's a challenge that should prove to be above your abilities, so don't feel too bad if you can't face up to it.
rows.quest:257:details:1: BA flock of buzzards has nested here in ⟦E2⟧. Why don't you try to take down some of the beasts? Tell you what, if you meet my challenge in fifteen minutes, I'll give you my bow or gun.
rows.quest:257:details:3: BIt seems you haven't much to lose, anyways.
rows.quest:257:completion:1: BTake it from me, ⟦12⟧ama, you don't let it get to your head. I mean, any unshaven boy with a bow could have killed such... small specimens. And I hope you don't enjoy killing the buzzards so much, yes? We wouldn't want them to become extinct.
rows.quest:257:completion:2: BWell, err... Never let it be said that Daryl the Bold would not hold to his word.
rows.quest:258:obj:0: Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.
rows.quest:258:details:0: ⟦13⟧ath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.
rows.quest:258:details:1: BYou should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.
rows.quest:258:details:2: BDon't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!
rows.quest:258:details:3: BHave I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...
rows.quest:258:completion:0: You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.
rows.quest:258:completion:1: BOh! You managed to kill the boars? I... well, that is... that is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have--bet?
rows.quest:263:obj:0: Mountaineer Wallbang in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter ⟦E5⟧ and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.
rows.quest:263:details:0: The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, ⟦14⟧. We need a ⟦15⟧ like you around here. The Trogg problem isn't getting any better. The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here. But now that we have a seasoned ⟦16⟧ here, let's see what you can do.
rows.quest:263:details:1: BGo out and kill 10 Stonesplinter ⟦E5⟧ and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers. Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
rows.quest:263:completion:0: I knew the second I laid eyes on you, ⟦17⟧, that you would make ⟦E3⟧ proud. You have served King Magni well. Now that you've proven yourself to be such a loyal aid to the Kingdom, perhaps you should talk with the Captain to see if he'll entrust you with a higher detail.
rows.quest:267:obj:0: Bring 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.
rows.quest:267:details:0: ⟦19⟧, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands. With the ⟦E3⟧ Reserve called up to the ⟦E4⟧ Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe. My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.
rows.quest:267:details:1: BBut we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills. If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs. Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.
rows.quest:267:completion:0: I am quite impressed, ⟦20⟧. You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands. King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
rows.quest:271:obj:0: Kill Ol' Sooty then show your handiwork to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge.
rows.quest:271:details:0: I don't suppose you'd be interested in a little payback for His Boldness? Daryl does have some skill, it pains me to say.
rows.quest:271:details:1: BA year ago, a large bear had been the target of the Farstrider Lodge, but none of the hunters had any luck with him. So, Daryl thought he'd try his hand against him. All he had to show for his effort was that ugly scar over his eye.
rows.quest:271:details:2: BKill the bear, and I'm sure even Daryl would be speechless for once.
rows.quest:271:details:3: BThe bear, Ol' Sooty, can be found around his lair in the hills over Thelsamar.
rows.quest:271:completion:0: Er... what's this? A bear's head, by the looks at it.
rows.quest:271:completion:1: B<He runs a finger along his scar unconsciously.>
rows.quest:271:completion:2: BWell, that's quite an interesting kill you have yourself there. Couldn't be that bear from back then...
rows.quest:271:completion:3: B<He trails off then starts to visibly shake.>
rows.quest:271:completion:4: BOh, take that away take it away! Get that grisly thing out of here!
rows.quest:273:details:0: It's not too late though, you're welcome to go look for Huldar. He can't have made it very far, strong as they are, Miran and Saean can only move so fast laden down with those barrels.
rows.quest:273:details:1: BThey're taking the normal route to the site, leaving south out of town and following the curve of the Loch.
rows.quest:273:details:2: BShouldn't have a problem finding them unless they've already gotten there.
rows.quest:273:completion:0: Hmph, it'll take more than a Dark Iron ambush to stop the deliveries!
rows.quest:273:completion:1: BBut Saean... I would never have suspected him to be one of their sympathizers. We've been working with him for almost a year now... maybe I missed the signs.
rows.quest:274:obj:0: Ashlan Stonesmirk wants you to return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and inform him of the new discovery.
rows.quest:274:details:0: This ain't no ordinary blast powder. Look at the tiny silver crystals. And the distinct smell! Why it's clear as daylight that this is Seaforium Powder. Seaforium is harmless enough. But once it's wet it could blow ⟦E3⟧ out of the mountain.
rows.quest:274:details:1: BThe chemical reaction can be defused by mixing four components: lurker venom, crushed Mo'Grosh crystal, a crocolisk tear and this disarming colloid. Now tell Hinderweir before it's too late!
rows.quest:274:completion:0: A disarming colloid? For Seaforium? Oh heavens!
rows.quest:278:obj:0: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to gather Lurker Venom, a Mo'grosh Crystal, and a Crocolisk Tear.
rows.quest:278:details:0: Begin collecting the disarming materials immediately, ⟦21⟧. Lurker Venom can be found on the indigenous spiders in ⟦E2⟧. Crocolisk tears are found here in the Loch as well. But a Mo'Grosh crystal will be very difficult to procure. The ogres to the northeast mine them but the crystals are a very rare commodity.
rows.quest:278:details:1: BWe need to be prepared to defuse a Dark Iron attack! Return to me once you've collected the needed items and I will prepare the mixture.
rows.quest:280:obj:0: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to swim down to the base of the dam, locate the powder keg and stir in the Disarming Mixture to prevent an explosion.
rows.quest:280:details:0: Earlier today I spotted some Dark Iron Insurgents swimming toward the Dam with a large keg. No Mountaineers were on hand to stop them! I'm afraid they've planted the Seaforium at the base of the Dam and it could blow at any minute! Let me combine all these ingredients into the Disarming Mixture. There we go.
rows.quest:280:details:1: BNow I need you to take this mixture and stir it into the keg before it's too late! Hurry!
rows.quest:280:completion:0: The keg fizzles slightly as the Disarming Mixture settles in.
rows.quest:283:obj:0: The Disarming Mixture seemed to take effect. Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir to report the good news.
rows.quest:283:completion:0: Thank you so much, ⟦23⟧!! You have saved the Stonewrought Dam! Without your help, the Dark Iron terrorists would have surely seen to this mighty landmark's demise. You have made the Kingdom and the ⟦E4⟧ proud, brave ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:283:completion:1: BThe Dam is once again safe. . . for the time being at least. . . .
rows.quest:297:obj:0: Bring Magmar Fellhew 8 Carved Stone Idols.
rows.quest:297:details:0: Recently, just before the Troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols. But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the Troggs chased us away from the ruins! And those idols have a strange effect on the Troggs. It makes them go berserk!
rows.quest:297:details:1: BBring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of Trogg hands! You can find the idols on the Troggs infesting the site.
rows.quest:297:completion:1: BAnd you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk Troggs about. I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
rows.quest:298:obj:0: Bring ⟦E6⟧'s Progress Report to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:298:details:0: I need a progress report sent to Thelsamar - a progress report, and a restatement of my request for more blastpowder! Here's the report. Take it to Jern Hornhelm. He's our local contact in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:298:details:1: BIt's not a difficult task, but it must be done.
rows.quest:298:completion:0: Bah! ⟦E6⟧'s having trouble with the Troggs. I wonder if he wants that blastpowder to aid his digging, or to aid his efforts against the Trogg beasts...
rows.quest:298:completion:1: BWell, either way it's powder well spent!
rows.quest:298:completion:2: BBut what's strange is, I sent him plenty of blastpowder weeks ago. I wonder where it went...
rows.quest:301:obj:0: Take ⟦E6⟧'s Progress Report to Prospector Stormpike.
rows.quest:301:details:0: We'll need approval to get ⟦E6⟧ more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:301:details:1: BHere's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of ⟦E6⟧'s slow progress at the site.
rows.quest:301:details:2: BYou'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.
rows.quest:301:completion:0: Curse that ⟦E6⟧! I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.
rows.quest:302:obj:0: Speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:302:details:0: If ⟦E6⟧ still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it! I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar. He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:302:details:1: BAnd one more thing: I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination. The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.
rows.quest:302:completion:0: What? Stormpike wants you to personally see the shipment to ⟦E6⟧?
rows.quest:302:completion:1: BI... suppose that's fine, the only problem is, I've already sent Huldar with the porters, Miran and Saean. You just missed them, they left just a short while ago.
rows.quest:307:obj:0: Go to the Silver Stream Mine and collect 4 loads of Miners' Gear.
rows.quest:307:details:0: The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago. It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!
rows.quest:307:details:1: BWe'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things. It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.
rows.quest:307:details:2: BThe gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine. Good luck.
rows.quest:307:completion:0: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there? I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine. The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
rows.quest:309:obj:0: Ensure Miran and the shipment arrive at the excavation site, then inform Prospector ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:309:details:1: BFirst, we need to get this powder to ⟦E6⟧. It'll be a lot for me to carry, and these parts can get dangerous -- and who knows what else the Dark Irons might have in store for me.
rows.quest:309:details:2: BI'll feel a lot better with you coming along.
rows.quest:309:completion:0: Oh, thank the Light the powder is here. But it is troubling news that you bring as well. To think that the Dark Irons have sympathizers able to procure this sort of material for their dastardly plans.
rows.quest:309:completion:1: BThat's a matter for someone else to consider, some other time. I must put this powder to good use.
rows.quest:385:obj:0: Get 5 pieces of Crocolisk Meat and 6 Crocolisk Skins for Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge.
rows.quest:385:details:0: Many a hunter is attracted to ⟦E2⟧ to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or armor, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat.
rows.quest:385:details:1: BWe do some trade in this, but not a huge amount, as the crocolisks are ferocious and have entrenched themselves on the islands in the Loch. But don't let me dissuade you, it's quite an experience, wrestling with the jaws of the beasts.
rows.quest:385:completion:0: Well now, these are excellent specimens you collected, ⟦27⟧. Good money for high quality materials, that's for sure.
rows.quest:416:obj:0: Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:416:details:0: We have a real infestation problem to the west. Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!
rows.quest:416:details:1: BWe want them eliminated. Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.
rows.quest:416:details:2: BYou can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
rows.quest:416:completion:0: Ugh! When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!
rows.quest:418:obj:0: Bring 3 pieces of Bear Meat, 3 Boar Intestines, and 3 Spider Ichor to Vidra Hearthstove in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:418:details:0: There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?
rows.quest:418:details:1: BNo? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy ⟦29⟧, you'll be any exception.
rows.quest:418:details:2: BI'll need bear meat, boar intestines for the casings, and spider ichor for spice. You get me some of those, and leave the cooking to Vidra!
rows.quest:418:completion:0: Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...
rows.quest:418:completion:1: BOh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
rows.quest:436:details:0: Prospector ⟦E6⟧ is heading an excavation of ancient ruins east of the lake. His progress has been slow lately, especially considering all the supplies we've sent him.
rows.quest:436:details:1: BIronband's a stout, honest dwarf who values results, which has me worried that forces are at work against him.
rows.quest:436:details:2: BGo to ⟦E6⟧'s Excavation and speak with Magmar Fellhew. He manages the details of the site and will know why there's a slowdown.
rows.quest:436:details:3: BTo get to the excavation site, go around the southern tip of the lake, then head east.
rows.quest:436:completion:0: Jern wants to know what the slowdown is, eh?
rows.quest:436:completion:1: BIronband is putting together his latest progress report with details, but I can tell you this:
rows.quest:454:details:0: We'd been hauling the barrels of powder back and forth in trips before this... business. Now we have to split up the work, Miran's taking the barrels and I'm watching over the other ones.
rows.quest:454:details:1: BI don't feel safe letting Miran haul the rest of the shipment by himself. When he's ready to go, maybe you could escort him on his next trip?
rows.quest:454:completion:1: BYou'll be escorting me to the excavation site? That's good to hear... After Saean and his cronies, who knows what else the Dark Irons might have up their sleeves?
rows.quest:454:completion:2: BAnyways, let me just make some final checks. Talk to me again when you're ready to go.
rows.quest:531:obj:0: Bring Ol' Sooty's head to Vyrin Swiftwind at the Farstrider Lodge.
rows.quest:531:details:0: Light! Don't bring things like that into the Lodge... it's unsanitary, unspeakable, un... un... unsanitary!
rows.quest:531:details:1: BJust get it out of here, will you? No one wants to see your bloody little trophy, really!
rows.quest:531:completion:0: Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, ⟦31⟧. I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! Here, have this, you've earned it.
rows.quest:1338:obj:0: Bring Stormpike's Request to Furen Longbeard in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1338:details:0: There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly. His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched. I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!
rows.quest:1338:details:1: BThe problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within ⟦E7⟧. In human lands! I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from ⟦E3⟧. The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!
rows.quest:1338:details:2: BSo, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
rows.quest:1338:completion:0: Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes. That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves. Rich ones, too.
rows.quest:1338:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦32⟧. I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
rows.quest:1339:details:0: I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner. Someone to do a little traveling for him. How about it? Are you the ⟦33⟧ for the job?
rows.quest:1339:details:1: BIf so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
rows.quest:1339:completion:0: That's right. I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding. In fact, it'll take you far from ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2038:obj:1: BBingles' Wrench, Bingles' Screwdriver, Bingles' ⟦E8⟧, and Bingles' Blastencapper.
rows.quest:2038:details:0: As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the nearby island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no chance!
rows.quest:2038:details:1: BGet my tools back and find my Blastencapper explosives, ⟦34⟧. For Gnomeregan!
rows.quest:2038:completion:0: You've done the movement a great service, ⟦35⟧. The troggs and leper gnomes infesting Gnomeregan will soon feel the brunt of a gnomish air assault!
rows.quest:2500:obj:0: Acquire the reagents Ghak Healtouch needs from the ⟦E9⟧, then return to him in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:2500:details:0: ⟦36⟧, I would make use of your services. I am an alchemist of some note, and I seek your aid in acquiring some reagents found out in the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:2500:details:1: BI need the following items to replenish my stocks: five buzzard gizzards, ten crag coyote fangs, and five rock elemental shards. Obviously, you can get them off of the beasties themselves; if you're not the fighting type, then find friends who are.
rows.quest:2500:details:2: BAcquire these items for me, you'll get some coin out of the deal.
rows.quest:2500:completion:0: Ah, well done ⟦37⟧. These should last me for a little while at least. Here is your pay, as promised.
rows.quest:2500:completion:1: BIf you're interested, I have some more reagents I could use. These, however, are only found in the depths of the Uldaman excavation. They will not be easy to get, but I will make it worth your while if you are interested in helping me again.
rows.quest:2500:completion:2: BPerhaps something more than some shiny coins, yes?
rows.quest:2501:obj:0: Use the empty thaumaturgy vessels on scorched guardian dragons found in the ⟦E9⟧. Once you have them filled, bring them to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:2501:details:0: You have been most helpful to me, ⟦38⟧. I would like to reward you with the very recipe for the brew I gave you earlier, but I must ask of you a favor that is quite dangerous.
rows.quest:2501:details:1: BThis lockbox contains three empty thaumaturgy vessels; they are imbued with an attunement aura that will drain the blood of a scorched guardian dragon. Using one on the beast will anger it greatly, so be careful. Once you have all three filled, bring them to me.
rows.quest:2501:details:2: BDo this, and the recipe will be yours.
rows.quest:2501:completion:0: From one alchemist to another, I salute you. Here, take this recipe and commit it to your knowledge. May it bring you the success and rewards that it has brought me over the years!
rows.quest:3182:obj:0: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Curator Thorius in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:3182:details:0: You expect me to believe a story like that? The real horn would have had my broken axe head still lodged into its surface.
rows.quest:3182:details:1: BListen, take that obvious fake to Curator Thorius in ⟦E3⟧. If he can validate your claim, you will receive a proof of deed. Bring that proof back to me and I'll give you the key to the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:3182:completion:1: BOh my, I don't believe it! Do you realize what you've got here, ⟦39⟧? This is the horn of Margol the Rager! Margol, the bane of every archaeologist that ever set foot in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:6387:obj:0: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:6387:details:0: I see a lot of young dwarves at my door, eager to learn the trade of mining. And if there's one thing a miner needs more than anything, it's a pick!
rows.quest:6387:details:1: BI have a list of mining students who scored high in their lessons and earned an honorary pick. Take my list to Golnir Bouldertoe in ⟦E3⟧. He'll get the picks ready.
rows.quest:6387:details:2: BThe fastest way to ⟦E3⟧ is on a gryphon, so bring the list to our gryphon master, Thorgrum Borrelson, and speak with him about transport to ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6387:completion:0: You have to get this to ⟦E3⟧, eh? For a small fee I can put you on the back of one of my gryphons, and it'll take you there. How does that sound?
rows.quest:6388:obj:0: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6388:details:0: Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students. If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!
rows.quest:6388:details:1: BTake the picks to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Thelsamar.
rows.quest:6388:completion:0: You have to get these to Thelsamar, eh? That won't be a problem. As long as you've already been to Thelsamar and spoken to Thorgrum Borrelson, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.
rows.quest:6391:obj:0: Buy a gryphon to ⟦E3⟧ from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6391:details:0: For just a few coins, one of my gryphons will take you to ⟦E3⟧. From there, deliver Brock's list to Golnir Bouldertoe. You'll find him in the Deep Mountain ⟦E11⟧ Guild. That's in the Great Forge District of ⟦E3⟧, which is right where my gryphon will drop you off!
rows.quest:6391:details:1: BSpeak to me again when you're ready for the journey.
rows.quest:6391:completion:0: Ah, the lastest list of Brock's best pupils. I have a batch of honorary picks ready to go. I just need to chisel in the names of the students...
rows.quest:6392:obj:0: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:6392:details:0: For a small fee you can buy a gryphon ride to Thelsamar... as long as you've already been there. Gryphons will only fly you to places you've already been, so be sure to speak with every gryphon master you see so you can fly to him later.
rows.quest:6392:details:1: BYou've already been to Thorgrum, the gryphon master of Thelsamar, so now you can return to him. And once in Thelsamar, you can deliver the picks to Brock Stoneseeker.
rows.quest:6392:details:2: BSpeak with me when you're ready to go.
rows.quest:6392:completion:0: You brought the picks. Great! I'll get these to my mining students. I'm sure they're eager to use them on the ore deposits of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6392:completion:1: BThank you for your help, ⟦40⟧. I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.
